authority.scope: Prospective repository research using synthetic scenarios, simulated funds, and role-labeled operational records.
authority.evidence: Explicit approval supplied through the authenticated project workspace task.
authority.approvalTextNormalized: for O1 you have all my approval and validation and anything else must be done by yourself

dataScope.amendmentTrigger: Any human participant, personal data, sensitive data, or human-coded outcome requires a new prospective governance and review decision before collection.

responsibleRoles.projectOperator: approves research scope and protocol amendments
responsibleRoles.researchOperator: executes registered protocols and records deviations
responsibleRoles.integrityVerifier: runs the production verifier and independent Rust verifier
responsibleRoles.dataSteward: enforces retention, quarantine, and deletion policy
responsibleRoles.independentReviewer: remains unfilled until an eligible second-person review is recorded

fundingPolicy.rule: No research result may describe simulated funds, fees, blocks, or receipts as financially incurred or publicly finalized.

retentionPolicy.eligibleResearchEvidence: retain indefinitely with immutable manifests and checksums
retentionPolicy.developmentPayloads: eligible for purge after 30 days while metadata, manifests, receipts, and audit logs remain
retentionPolicy.accidentalSensitiveMaterial: quarantine immediately, exclude from research, and delete after incident documentation

claimBoundary: This decision authorizes a synthetic, simulation-funded repository study. It is not institutional ethics approval, external registration, independent review, or evidence that any public-chain transaction occurred.
